article.title: Effectiveness of Traditional Chinese Fitness Methods on Depressive Symptoms and Glycaemic Control in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes and Comorbid Depression: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Taijiquan and Baduanjin.
article.authors: Tian X, Wei Y, Bo J
article.abstract: To evaluate the overall effectiveness of traditional Chinese fitness methods (TCFMs)-specifically Taijiquan and Baduanjin-on depressive symptoms and glycaemic control in patients with Type 2 diabetes (T2DM) and comorbid depression.
